facts.fact: Bethany 叫了一辆 Uber，把自己送到数百英里内唯一让她稍感安全的地方——Lubbock 的 premier miniature golf course and family fun center（即 Turbo Putt）。
facts.anchor: So she called an Uber and delivered herself to the only place in hundreds of miles where she felt even remotely safe: Lubbock’s premier miniature golf course and family fun center.

facts.fact: Jules 打开屋后 shed 的门，Bethany 走进去倒在角落的 twin mattress 上。
facts.anchor: They opened the door to the shed around the back. Bethany staggered in, then collapsed onto the twin mattress in the corner.

facts.fact: Bethany 想起后面藏着的那把小手枪（little handgun），走过 shed、挪开 mini fridge，慢慢把枪拿了起来。
facts.anchor: Then she remembered the little handgun back there. She walked across the shed, moved the mini fridge out of the way, and picked it up slowly.

facts.fact: 睡前 Bethany 对 Jules 说：如果半夜看到 static people 从她脑子里爬出来，必须立刻叫醒她。
facts.anchor: “No,” Bethany said. She could already feel sleep overtaking her. “What I mean is, if you see any static people crawl out of my head in the middle of the night, you need to wake me up immediately.”

facts.fact: Jules 说“那是 symptom”，显得兴奋，躺到 Bethany 旁边的床垫上，接连追问她是否一直做噩梦、身体是否发麻、是否见过那家 video store。
facts.anchor: “That’s a symptom,” Jules said. They sounded excited. They lay down on the mattress next to Bethany. “Have you been having nightmares?” they asked. “Has your body been feeling numb? Have you seen the video store?”

facts.fact: Jules 打开 Bethany 的手机相册，发现了 Bethany 在 GlobalVill 录下的笔记本屏幕视频——Jules 割腕的那一段；当初录它是为了向 Douglas 证明 Jules 需要帮助，那时 Jules 还只是她笔记本屏幕上的陌生人。
facts.anchor: They’d opened up Bethany’s photo library and found the camera video Bethany had recorded of her laptop screen at GlobalVill. The one of Jules cutting their wrists that Bethany had recorded to prove to Douglas that Jules needed help, back when Jules had still been just a stranger on her laptop screen.

facts.fact: Bethany 躲闪砸来的手机——手机撞上墙、屏幕摔碎，弹落到她床边，撞掉了她几小时前刚贴的一张杂志剪页。
facts.anchor: Bethany ducked as it slammed against the wall, knocking down one of the magazine clippings she’d hung just hours earlier. Her phone screen shattered, then bounced down onto the bed next to her.

facts.fact: Jules 喝令“永远别回来”（Don’t ever come back!），Bethany 冲过球场逃走；Jules 冲她喊自己有枪、而且不怕用。
facts.anchor: “Don’t ever come back!” Jules shouted. Bethany rushed across the course. “I’ve got a gun and I’m not afraid to use it!”
